slides.headline: Musk will give every US kid 2 SpaceX shares
slides.subline: **About $18 billion.** Announced hours after a huge space approval.
slides.credit: Steve Jurvetson / CC BY 2.0 (Starship, file photo)

slides.body: Elon Musk said on **Wednesday evening** that every child in the US will get [[two SpaceX shares]]. Reuters values the giveaway at about **$18 billion**.
SpaceX says it will add **one new share** to each active Trump Account. Musk says he will [[match it personally]] once his lockup ends, in June next year.
It came **hours after** SpaceX won US approval to deploy [[1 million satellites]] for data centres in space, as scrutiny of tech firms grows.
Analysts call it a **charm offensive** for SpaceX and AI. Bloomberg reports Musk also promised [[another share every year]].
Generous gift or smart PR? Tell us what you think below.
